title: Following the Prophet
narrator: ʿAbd Allāh bin ʿAmr bin al-ʿĀṣ
arabic_text: عَنْ [أَبي مُحَمّدٍ عَبْدِ اللهِ بنِ عَمْرِو بنِ العاصِ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُما قالَ: (قالَ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هَواهُ تَبَعًا لِمَا جِئْتُ بِهِ").
english_translation: From Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd ِAllāh bin ʿAmr bin al-ʿĀṣ (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhumā) who said: The Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'None of you truly believes until his inclination is in accordance with what I have brought.'
description: This Hadith emphasizes that true faith requires one's desires and inclinations to be in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. It calls for complete submission to the Sunnah.
